cells.title: Find convention manifests up to two directories down

truths: detect_static_checks on the beehive repo root returns cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings with source packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml
a repo with a root Cargo.toml still gets cargo clippy -- -D warnings with source Cargo.toml
every existing onboard::notices test stays green

cells.action: Implement CONTEXT.md D1 and D2 in packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/notices.rs. Add one private finder that returns the candidate manifest paths relative to root for a file name (or a suffix such as .csproj): root first, then depth 1, then depth 2, each depth sorted by relative path, skipping directories whose name starts with '.' and node_modules, target, vendor, dist, build. In static_check_for, take the first candidate whose text satisfies the table (empty table = any) and build the command from its location: root keeps the exact current text; nested gives cargo clippy --manifest-path <rel> -- -D warnings, ruff check <dir>, go -C <dir> vet ./..., mypy <dir>; source = rel path; marker unchanged. In detect_commands conventions: pyproject -> pytest or pytest <dir>, csproj -> dotnet test (root, source = file name as today) or dotnet test <rel csproj>, go.mod -> go test ./... or go -C <dir> test ./...; source = rel path. Use forward slashes in rel paths. package.json, Makefile, composer.json stay root-only. Sync docs/knowledge/areas/onboarding/host-project-artifacts.md: the sentence that says detect_static_checks reads the project's own root files now says root then up to two directories down, cite docs/history/monorepo-manifest-detect/CONTEXT.md D1/D2 (never raw ids). Run bee knowledge check. No code comments. Do not add new tests; mmd-2 owns them. Proof: the verify command; quote the counts.

cells.title: Test nested manifest detection

truths: a nested packages/app/Cargo.toml gives cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/app/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
a root manifest beats a nested one
a manifest three directories down or under node_modules, target or a hidden directory is not found
nested go.mod gives go -C <dir> test ./... from detect_commands
commands_notices names the nested clippy command when commands.test lacks clippy

cells.action: Verify the mmd-1 commit against CONTEXT.md D1 and D2, then add tests to the tests module of packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/onboard/notices.rs that check every clause of contract nested-manifest-detect (decision 641b2eb3). Test names carry static_check (trust-layers C1) or nested_manifest. Use temp-dir repos and the existing static_check_repo helper where it fits. Assert observable output (command, source) only. If mmd-1 breaks the contract, return BLOCKED with the failing output instead of changing the production code. No code comments. Proof: the verify command; quote the counts and name the new tests.
